Privacy policy

Your moments. Your privacy.

What the website handles, and what happens when you share information.

Updated 16 October 2026

Information you choose to share

Booking enquiries ask for contact details, event information and your brief. Creator applications ask for contact details, location, device, portfolio links and selected media. Editing requests ask for contact details, clips and editing preferences. Avoid including sensitive personal information that is not needed for the request.

Drafts and online submissions

The forms currently download a draft to your device. Selecting files creates local previews; it does not upload them. A downloaded draft is not a submitted enquiry or a confirmed booking. If online submissions are enabled, the form will identify the sending action and show a result. Submitted information is used to respond to the request, assess an application or arrange the agreed service.

Media and service providers

When online submission is enabled, our intake integration stores enquiry details in Google Sheets and uploaded media in private Google Drive folders for the team to handle. Hosting, fonts and image providers also receive technical information needed to deliver their services. Some gallery images load from external image providers.

Cookies and technical information

The website’s application code does not set advertising cookies or use local storage for tracking. Your browser still makes requests to the hosting provider, Google Fonts and external image providers, which can receive information such as your IP address and browser details. Their own privacy policies apply to their services.

Keeping and removing information

Downloaded drafts remain under your control on your own device. For information you have actually sent to the team, request access, correction or deletion through your confirmed team contact. Some records may need to remain for an active project, dispute or applicable recordkeeping requirement.

Privacy contact

Our dedicated contact email is being set up. The address hello@thereelwala.example is a placeholder and does not accept messages. Until a working contact is published, use your existing confirmed team contact for any information you have already shared.
